screen.title: Notifications
screen.intro: Set meal reminders and Fitaly notifications.
screen.smartReminderHint: Times reminders around your day and quiet hours.
screen.smartReminderUnavailableBody: This feature is paused for now. You can still control other notifications below.
screen.permissionOnBody: Fitaly can gently send meal reminders and summaries on this device.
screen.permissionOffBody: Turn on system notifications if you want to receive meal reminders and other notification types on time.
screen.permissionCheckingBody: Fitaly is still checking whether this device can receive notifications.

meal_reminder.title: Time to eat
meal_reminder.body_detailed: You usually eat {{meal}} now. Add it to keep your log accurate.

calorie_goal.title: Calorie goal
calorie_goal.body_detailed: You are about {{kcal}} kcal below your goal. Consider a light meal.

day_fill.title: Fill the day
day_fill.body_detailed: It looks like today is empty. Add meals to keep your history complete.

permissions.title: Enable notifications
permissions.message: Turn on notifications in system settings if you want to receive reminders, including Smart Reminders, on time.
